items.title: What happens when you take AutoCAD out of the computer? 🚧 Our Grading Workshop made its way to Charleston, where 37 eng...
items.description:
What happens when you take AutoCAD out of the computer? 🚧
 
Our Grading Workshop made its way to Charleston, where 37 engineers across four groups put CAD concepts into practice in the field. Using string to recreate AutoCAD lines outside, they explored how decisions made on the computer impact real-world site conditions and why a well-organized project setup matters from the start.
 
Another great round of hands-on learning, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing!
